& 'D:\projects\control-agent-harness\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -B -c 'import numpy as np
import torch
from solution import heat, lift, policy_cost
from actuator import Actuator
from teacher import stage, stage_cost

torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float64)
z = torch.tensor([[0.3, 0.12], [-0.8, 0.7]])
w = torch.tensor(1.4, requires_grad=True)
spec = dict(C=2300., G=7., time_scale_min=5., time_origin_min=8., y_shift_C=14., y_scale_K=2.3, Ta_C=13.)
v = heat(lambda i: w*i[:,:1]**2+i[:,1:2],z,spec)
t,p = z[:, :1],z[:,1:2]
deriv = 2300*2.3*2*t/300+7*2.3*t**2
expected = deriv*w+7*(1+2.3*p)-1000*p
torch.testing.assert_close(v, expected)
torch.testing.assert_close(torch.autograd.grad(v.sum(),w)[0], deriv.sum())
assert heat(None,z,{}) is None
assert not z.requires_grad
constant = heat(lambda i:w.expand(i.shape[0],1), z,spec)
torch.testing.assert_close(constant, 7*(1+2.3*w)-1000*p)
rng = np.random.default_rng(106)
for horizon in (1,2,6,15):
    for trial in range(5):
        coeff = dict(zip(("a","b","c","d","g"),rng.uniform(-1.3,1.3,5)))
        initial = rng.normal(size=3)
        du = rng.normal(size=horizon)
        device = Actuator(coeff,*initial[:2])
        readings = [device.step(cmd) for cmd in initial[-1]+du.cumsum()]
        f,mat = lift(coeff,horizon)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(f@initial+mat@du,readings,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-10)
cfg = dict(N=5,beta=.39,a=.82,b=-.6,limit=1.8,center=.17,scale=.87,q=1.3,r=.13,s=.47,discount=.91)
x = torch.tensor([[-.4],[3.8],[.1]])
ref = torch.tensor([[.35],[-.1],[.04]])
last = torch.tensor([[.6],[.03],[-.78]])
slope = torch.tensor(.72,requires_grad=True)
def scalar_cost(wgt, coupled):
    result = []
    for state,reference,previous in zip(x.flatten().tolist(),ref.flatten().tolist(),last.flatten().tolist()):
        trajectory = 0
        for k in range(cfg["N"]):
            next_state, applied = stage(lambda i:wgt*i[0]-.28*i[1],state,reference,previous,cfg)
            if coupled:
                next_state += .07*state*applied
            trajectory += cfg["discount"]**k * stage_cost(next_state,reference,applied,previous,cfg)
            state,previous = next_state,applied
        result.append(trajectory)
    return np.mean(result)
for coupled in (False, True):
    value = policy_cost(lambda i:slope*i[:,:1]-.28*i[:,1:], lambda i:.07*i[:,:1]*i[:,1:],x,ref,last,cfg,coupled)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(value.item(),scalar_cost(slope.item(),coupled))
    step = 1e-6
    fd = (scalar_cost(slope.item()+step,coupled)-scalar_cost(slope.item()-step,coupled))/(2*step)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(torch.autograd.grad(value,slope)[0].item(),fd,rtol=1e-6,atol=1e-7)
print("All three self-checks passed")'
